rules: Read only by mtg-kernel/src/bin/card_semantics_table_v1; no rules code reads this file.
A source is a card-named token the walker would emit: leaf:<EffectOp variant>, trigger:<TriggerCondition variant>, cond:<EffectCond variant> or costpart:<CostComponent variant>.
An entry replaces the source and its field tokens with the shared tokens the generic definition of the same rules yields (kind, amount, target or player reference).
Every entry cites what the leaf's implementation does in one line. A leaf whose behaviour has no faithful generic composition is left unmapped and stays its own token.
